pre_registered.A1_no_lost_agreement: the 08:00 arm may not lose any DECIDED agreement the 09:30 arm had, compared by MEMBERSHIP of the agreeing sessions and never by count
pre_registered.A2_window_is_never_the_fix: a degradation at 08:00 is an early-entry defect IN THE BRAIN; this module may not recommend moving, narrowing or reverting the window
pre_registered.A3_unconditional_deployment_window: 08:00-12:00 is unconditional, so a failing 08:00 arm BLOCKS FREEZE; there is no 09:30-deployed fallback. A pass is a precondition for FREEZE, not a grant of it
pre_registered.A4_censoring: right-censored trader labels are excluded from both numerator and denominator on both arms; classes are reported beside the verdict, never folded into it
pre_registered.A5_never_by_score: no PnL, realized outcome, winner/loser label or clean-edge result participates; the verdict is a function of the pre-registered predicates only

teaching_evidence_note: rationale for the 08:00 window and the taught mechanics. NO exam-set change, no label, no new route, no code derived from a screenshot: if the brain cannot produce the taught behaviour, this exam convicts it.

asymmetric_censoring_diagnostic.question: trader-side non-decision is excluded from both numerator and denominator; bot-side non-decision is counted as a disagreement. Should it also be excluded, or is an unavailable bot a real failure that must count?
asymmetric_censoring_diagnostic.why_it_is_not_adopted: it raises the fidelity number, and a party may not adopt the reading that flatters it. This is an ALGO question, not a worker decision.

verdict.why_A1_alone_is_insufficient: A1 compares the two arms to each other; a brain that regressed against the frozen baseline on BOTH arms loses nothing BETWEEN them and would pass A1
verdict.offsetting_is_forbidden: a gained session may never offset a lost one; A1 is a membership test precisely so a regression cannot be laundered by an unrelated improvement
verdict.what_a_failure_means: an EARLY-ENTRY DEFECT IN THE BRAIN on the sessions named in lost_agreements (ALGO-043). The window is never the fix and never the casualty; repairs are ruled from this evidence, not chosen here.
verdict.freeze: BLOCKED. 08:00-12:00 is unconditional and there is no 09:30-deployed fallback (ALGO-049 §3).
